status: criteria declared before retention benchmark execution
purpose: Isolate physical retention in Ravens before further Transporter training
development_matrix: 108 cases: 3 families x 3 sizes x 3 grasp yaws x 2 pick positions x 2 transfer distances
diagnostic_protocol: Ground-truth centered grasp, short lift, 0.5-second hold, high lift, transfer, 2-second hold, lowering; baseline finger control. This deliberately differs from the production primitive and is not a policy evaluation.
retention_definition: After a successful short lift, bilateral contact at every sampled checkpoint (20 Hz), relative object translation <=5 mm and rotation <=10 degrees from the short-lift reference through lowering; no timeout or exception. Sampling cannot exclude slips between samples.

promotion_gates.development: At least 95% complete retention overall and at least 90% in each object family; failures and timeouts included. This is a screening gate, not held-out evidence.
promotion_gates.fresh_retention: Freeze candidate; 300 new randomized cases (100 per family), >=95% overall and >=90% per family, with confidence intervals and geometry-specific failures reported. Do not tune on these cases.
promotion_gates.stacking_validation: Compare frozen controller with baseline on matching validation scenes, with fixed Transporter weights; improve completion without hiding errors or increasing action/time budgets.
promotion_gates.stage_clearance: Frozen final policy/controller: >=90/100 complete towers on reserved test seeds 1000-1099, under existing 6-action, 180-second and 2-second hold protocol. Report uncertainty and all failures; not a claim of real-world reliability.

training_condition: Train a new model only after physical retention improves; preserve current datasets, models and scoring.
